objective: Test whether public intervention-learned signed direct links can persist and be composed into a query for a previously unobserved two-hop causal connection.

mechanism.learned: Bounded signed one-step edge support from paired public treatment/control observations
mechanism.not_learned: Generic deterministic graph traversal is designed, not learned; trial causality is externally assumed and not authenticated
mechanism.checkpoint: Canonical public-state SHA256 integrity marker, not a signed trusted scientific receipt

toy_data: Exactly eight handwritten public counterfactual pairs, repeated roles for A->B, B->C, C, decoy; NO seeded FIT/VALID/DEV or protected original cohorts
engineering_pass_conditions: A->C composition recovered after only A->B and B->C immediate evidence, A->C direct predictor abstains
Same mechanism succeeds on opaque entity renaming and after public-state checkpoint restore
Reset-state and equally exposed direct-only readout cannot report the absent direct A->C edge
Public treatment/control correlation with zero contrast does not create a causal edge
Contradictory signed effects abstain; malformed, privileged, future, extra-key and tampered input fail closed
Fixed 8 entity, 48 trial and 2 hop limits enforced
must_not_claim: Autonomous experimental discovery of causal laws
Learned composition operator, learned language, or native Wingless/Yggdrasil system
Transfer on source-disjoint held-out task families
Scientific GO, production FSA admission, or protected first use
next_real_science: After existing FSA authority independently qualifies first Wingless/Yggdrasil originals, prospectively admit independent ITD-01 O1 source births with equally trained control, frozen HELD task families and resource accounting; do not reuse these handwritten toy rows as unseen evaluation.
guardrails: No Q20/Q21/Q21N-01 frozen role cohorts or original research sources
No hidden/private causal-law input to learner
Do not modify or reclassify existing ITD-01 R1-R7 drafts or negative results
Source-only branch is not acceptance or promotion authority
